title: oxalis nipponica var. kantoensis
intro: Oxalis nipponica var. kantoensis, commonly known as the Japanese wood sorrel, is a species of flowering plant in the wood sorrel family, Oxalidaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from fever, diarrhea, and other gastrointestinal issues. The therapeutic actions of Oxalis nipponica var. kantoensis are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help in soothing digestive issues and reducing oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include oxalic acid, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
